day_line: A climbing vine on a Snake day. Quiet and clever: good for smart moves and patient talks, easy to overthink.

lines.Yang Wood: Someone eyes the last seat today. Offer it; you'll get the next one.
lines.Yin Wood: Friday feels easy with your crowd. Say yes to dinner; let someone else choose.
lines.Yang Fire: A treat comes your way today. Accept it and return the favour next week.
lines.Yin Fire: A clear thought comes late today. Jot it down before the weekend wipes it.
lines.Yang Earth: Your hard week gets noticed. Leave on time; you've earned it.
lines.Yin Earth: Friday adds one more task. Finish it tidy, then switch your phone to silent.
lines.Yang Metal: Sensible spending wins today. Set the weekend budget before the first drink.
lines.Yin Metal: A small win waits today. Send the email you drafted twice; it's ready.
lines.Yang Water: You're persuasive today. Pitch the weekend plan and keep the backup quiet.
lines.Yin Water: You're glowing today. Wear the nice shirt, take the photo, post it tomorrow.
